name: Shattuck (Tucker) Ely

about: Shattuck (Tucker) Ely attended law school and graduated from Georgetown University Law Center in 1997. Shattuck Ely began practicing law in 1997.
Shattuck Ely is an attorney at Fellows LaBriola, helping people with Insurance Coverage issues. Fellows LaBriola has an office in Atlanta, Georgia, serving the local community.

Shattuck Ely was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
